passages.title: Advanced Narrative: Motives and Themes
passages.text: When the town’s electricity failed during a storm, Nara was building a miniature solar lamp for a school project. She had one spare battery left. Across the hall, two younger children were trying to read the emergency instructions in the dark. Nara hesitated, looking at her unfinished model. Then she carried the battery to their lamp. The children read the instructions and found a safe room. Later, Nara could not complete her model that evening, but she felt less disappointed than she had expected.

questions.prompt: Which theme is most strongly supported?
choices: Every project must be finished in one night
Helping others can matter more than personal achievement
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.

choices: Semua proyek harus selesai satu malam
Menolong orang lain dapat lebih penting daripada pencapaian pribadi

questions.evidence: When the town’s electricity failed during a storm, Nara was building a miniature solar lamp for a school project.

choices: She did not know the children

She had been using the battery for her own project
questions.explanation: Keraguan muncul saat Nara memandang model yang belum selesai.

choices: Baterai itu sebelumnya untuk proyeknya sendiri

questions.prompt: What did the younger children need?
questions.explanation: Mereka membutuhkan cahaya untuk membaca instruksi.

questions.prompt: What does Nara’s final feeling suggest?

She did not notice the missing battery
questions.explanation: Kekecewaannya lebih kecil daripada perkiraannya setelah membantu.
